title: twbs/bootstrap
claim: twbs/bootstrap — The most popular HTML, CSS, and JavaScript framework for developing responsive, mobile first projects on the web.
why_good: The most-used CSS framework — mature, foundational OSS, not a foundable startup.
value: No monetization path; it's free infrastructure the whole web builds on.
risk: Ancient and ubiquitous; listed as a signal, with zero startup opening.

zh.claim: twbs/bootstrap —— 最流行的 HTML/CSS/JS 响应式、移动优先框架。
zh.why_good: 用得最多的 CSS 框架——成熟、基础的开源,不是可创办的创业。
zh.value: 没有变现路径;它是整个 Web 都在用的免费基础设施。
zh.risk: 古老且无处不在;当信号列出,零创业口子。
